- [ ] `yarn lint` passes.
- [ ] `yarn test` passes.
- [ ] `yarn build` passes.
- [ ] The diff was reviewed for correctness, security, and maintainability.
- [ ] Manual testing was completed when the change affects user-visible behavior.
